page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.6xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon processors, the instance delivers 24 dedicated virtual cores paired with 192.0 GB of system memory. This specific configuration establishes a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per allocated virtual CPU. The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Storage and networking architecture relies entirely on external services. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for all persistent data storage and operating system roots. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 12 Gbps, providing consistent throughput for external data replication, network volumes, and client connectivity. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:8 memory distribution makes ecs.u2i-c1m8.6xlarge suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require moderate core density alongside substantial memory headroom. Primary application targets include in-memory databases, large Redis caches, memory-resident analytics, medium-scale relational databases, and enterprise applications requiring high memory capacity without the necessity of excessive compute licensing.
